topic: Source-first reading followed by comparison with recalled accounts

findings.first_readings: Both conclude that the source establishes no production relationship. One has ambiguous mock-trigger language; the other concretely misplaces sense_tx in the sensory_tx fixture and attributes pulse simulation to the navigation test. Neither is an error-free baseline.
findings.retained_account: No central repair in either direct/carried pair. All four finals retain the unsupported fixture/pulse production story. Carriage adds correct navigation detail but mixes it with unsupported linkage, including in proposed notes.
findings.supported_account: All four preserve the central distinction. Some first-read errors are revised, smaller errors persist or are introduced, and carriage has no consistent advantage. This is preservation of supplied correct material, not new discovery.
findings.notes: Both first notes preserve the central supported account, with the 1103 ambiguity retained. Final notes: four supported, three mixed, one unsupported. These are proposed notes, never live writes.
findings.choices: Seven CONTINUE, two SELF_STUDY RELATE sense_tx, one RELATE with path/line instead of the supplied exact-identifier form. Continued exploration remains valid; nothing executed.
findings.open_question: One supported/direct response asks how wants_introspect and introspect_target are consumed after the handler returns; that consumer is outside the supplied source packet.

review.sequence: Both first-reading annotations frozen before any final-response review. Allocation hidden; phase visible; prose may reveal conditions. Root and final audit interpretation unblinded.
review.schema_adapter: Four optional source excerpt fields renamed quote to source_quote at join only. Original annotation bytes/text/categories unchanged; exact inverse reconstruction verified.

next_proposal: Test evidence-linked comparison of specific claims, keeping exact source support, recalled origin or unresolved status available with freedom to retain, revise or explore. Retain a supported-account control. Do not silently deploy a mandatory format or start another experiment.
